items.question: In UNO, can I stack a +2 on another +2?
items.expected_output: Official UNO rules do not allow stacking.

items.question: In UNO, can I play my card when it is not my turn, but color and number match?
items.expected_output: No. You can only play on your own turn.

must_include: only play on your own turn

items.question: In UNO, what happens if I forget to say UNO and someone catches me before the next turn starts?
items.expected_output: You draw 2 cards as penalty.

items.question: In UNO, can I choose to draw even if I have a playable card?
items.expected_output: Yes, you may choose not to play and draw one card.

items.question: In UNO, if I draw a playable card, may I play it immediately?
items.expected_output: Yes, if the drawn card can be played, you can play it in the same turn.

items.question: In UNO, can Wild card be played even if I have another playable card?
items.expected_output: Yes, Wild can be played even with another playable card.

items.question: In UNO, if the +4 challenge fails, what is the challenger's penalty?
items.expected_output: The challenger draws 6 cards total.

items.question: In UNO, what does Reverse do?
items.expected_output: It reverses direction of play.

items.question: In Werewolves, what does the Little Girl card do?
items.expected_output: She may peek only while Werewolves are awake; if caught, she is killed.

items.question: In Werewolves, can the Witch also be the Little Girl?
items.expected_output: No. A player has one character card.

items.question: In Werewolves, can the Witch use both potions in one night?
items.expected_output: Yes, both potions can be used in the same night.

items.question: In Werewolves, what happens if the Hunter dies?
items.expected_output: The Hunter must immediately choose one player to die with them.

items.question: In Werewolves, what happens if one Lover dies?
items.expected_output: The other lover immediately dies too.

items.question: In Werewolves, can dead players still talk during discussion?
items.expected_output: No, dead players must not speak or participate.

items.question: In Werewolves, when can the Little Girl peek?
items.expected_output: Only while Werewolves are awake.

must_include: only while the Werewolves are awake

items.question: In Werewolves, what if werewolves catch the Little Girl peeking?
items.expected_output: She is immediately killed instead of original victim.

items.question: In Werewolves, can the Witch heal herself?
items.expected_output: Yes, the Witch can use healing potion on herself.

must_include: CAN use the healing potion on herself

items.question: In Werewolves, how many votes does the Mayor have?
items.expected_output: The Mayor has two votes.

items.question: In Werewolves, if the Mayor dies, what happens next?
items.expected_output: The Mayor chooses a successor.

items.question: In Catan, what does the robber do?
items.expected_output: Unsupported game in this project.

items.question: In UNO, what does the Dragon card do?
items.expected_output: No matching official rule found for that card.
